title: Heteroleptic N, N donor carbonitrile based Au(III) complexes: DNA/BSA interaction studies, Molecular Docking, and cytotoxicity studies.
authors: Patel, Nikita J; Dabhi, Ravi A; Dhaduk, Milan P; Savaliya, Nirbhay K; Bhatt, Bhupesh S; Lunagariya, Miral V; Bhatt, Vaibhav D; Patel, Mohan N
journal: Journal of trace elements in medicine and biology : organ of the Society for Minerals and Trace Elements (GMS)
one_liner_zh: 研究Au(III)配合物与DNA/BSA的结合及细胞毒性，虽含DNA互作和分子对接，但对象为小分子金属配合物而非蛋白质-DNA体系，方法仅常规对接，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: A series of square planar substituted carbonitrile based Au(III) complexes (2a-2e) with the type of [(N;N)Au(Cl(2))](+)Cl(-) [Where, N;N = 5- Amino-3-phenyl-1-(pyridin-2-yl)-1H-pyrazole-4-carbonitrile (1a), 5-amino-3-(4-chlorophenyl)-1-(pyridin-2-yl)-1H-pyrazole-4-carbonitrile (1b), 5-amino-3-(4-bromophenyl)-1-(pyridin-2-yl)-1H-pyrazole-4-carbonitrile (1c), 5-amino-3-(4-flourophenyl)-1-(pyridin-2-yl)-1H-pyrazole-4-carbonitrile (1d), 5-amino-3-(4-methoxyphenyl)-1-(pyridin-2-yl)-1H-pyrazole-4-carbonitrile (1e) were synthesized and characterized by analytical techniques. UV-Vis spectroscopy, fluorescence spectroscopy, Viscosity measurements, and molecular docking studies were used to identify the binding mechanism between complexes and HS-DNA (Herring sperm-DNA), results suggest an intercalation mode of DNA binding. Protein binding studies of the complexes were evaluated using UV-visible and fluorescence spectroscopy. The antibacterial activity of the metal chelates were performed against three Gram (-ve) and two Gram (+ve) bacteria, and the results indicate that all of the complexes perform better than their ligands against microorganisms. The in vitro cytotoxicity against BSLB (Brine shrimp lethality bioassay) of ligands and metal chelates were also carried out. The LC(50) values of the ligands and complexes were found in the range of 10.45-13.28 microg/mL and 6.30-6.99 microg/mL, respectively. All compounds were tested for anti-cancer activity against the human adenocarcinoma (MCF-7) cancer cell line. The results show that effective toxicity against the tested cell line of all metal chelates. The SwissADME webserver analysis confirmed that most of the synthetic compounds comply with drug-likeness principles. Additionally, they demonstrated promising biological activities, indicating their potential for further drug development.
abstract_zh: 合成并表征了一系列具有[(N;N)Au(Cl(2))](+)Cl(-)类型的方形平面取代碳腈基Au(III)配合物（2a-2e）[其中，N;N = 5-氨基-3-苯基-1-(吡啶-2-基)-1H-吡唑-4-碳腈（1a），5-氨基-3-(4-氯苯基)-1-(吡啶-2-基)-1H-吡唑-4-碳腈（1b），5-氨基-3-(4-溴苯基)-1-(吡啶-2-基)-1H-吡唑-4-碳腈（1c），5-氨基-3-(4-氟苯基)-1-(吡啶-2-基)-1H-吡唑-4-碳腈（1d），5-氨基-3-(4-甲氧基苯基)-1-(吡啶-2-基)-1H-吡唑-4-碳腈（1e）]，并通过分析技术进行了表征。采用紫外-可见光谱、荧光光谱、粘度测量和分子对接研究来确定配合物与HS-DNA（鲱鱼精子DNA）之间的结合机制，结果表明存在嵌入式的DNA结合模式。利用紫外-可见和荧光光谱评估了配合物的蛋白质结合研究。对三种革兰氏阴性菌和两种革兰氏阳性菌进行了金属螯合物的抗菌活性测试，结果显示所有配合物对微生物的活性均优于其配体。还进行了配体和金属螯合物体外细胞毒性测试，采用BSLB（卤虫致死性生物测定）。配体和配合物的LC(50)值分别在10.45-13.28微克/毫升和6.30-6.99微克/毫升范围内。所有化合物均针对人腺癌（MCF-7）癌细胞系进行了抗癌活性测试。结果表明，所有金属螯合物对测试细胞系均表现出有效的毒性。SwissADME网络服务器分析确认，大多数合成化合物符合类药性原则。此外，它们展现出有前景的生物活性，表明其具有进一步药物开发的潜力。
